name: Metawells Oil & Gas Inc.
summary: Metawells Oil & Gas Inc. intends to operate as an oil producer that focuses on the multi-zone development and enhanced oil recovery. The company was formerly known as One Step Vending Corp. and changed its name to Metawells Oil & Gas Inc. in January 2024. Metawells Oil & Gas Inc. was incorporated in 2004 and is headquartered in Harrison, New York.
